title: A New Dawn Or A False Start
section_path: A New Dawn Or A False Start
section_path_text: A New Dawn Or A False Start
summary:
A new President has created excitement and uncertainty
Since the election of the new Nigerian president, Mr. Bola Ahmed Tinubu, who was inaugurated on May 29, 2023, the country has been frequently in the news. Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation, faces many challenges, both economic and social.
